caption_used: Accuracy comparison of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Each benchmark displays grouped bars for DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). In Mathverse, SRPO achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56%, while DAPO+Self-reflection follows at roughly 55%, with the remaining methods clustered between 53% and 54%. Across MMLU, GRPO leads with approximately 57%, narrowly exceeding DAPO+Self-reflection, and PPO trails at about 54.5%. In the Physics benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches roughly 61%, with SRPO close behind at 60.5% and PPO at the lowest with approximately 57%. Notably, the self-reflection variants do not consistently outperform their base counterparts, as GRPO surpasses PPO+Self-reflection in both Mathverse and MMLU.

raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The bar chart presents a comparison of accuracy percentages across three benchmarks—Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics—for six reinforcement learning configurations: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). The horizontal axis lists the three benchmarks in order: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, spans from 50% to 62% with major tick marks at 2% intervals. Within each benchmark group, the six methods are displayed as adjacent vertical bars, grouped by benchmark. In Mathverse, the solid orange bar (SRPO) reaches approximately 56%, followed by solid blue (DAPO+Self-reflection) at about 55.5%, while the remaining bars range between 53% and 54.5%. In MMLU, the hatched orange bar (GRPO) is highest at approximately 57%, followed closely by solid blue (DAPO+Self-reflection) at around 57%, with hatched green (PPO) at approximately 54.5%. In Physics, solid blue (DAPO+Self-reflection) peaks at roughly 61%, solid orange (SRPO) follows at about 60.5%, and hatched green (PPO) is lowest at approximately 57%. The self-reflection variants (solid bars) are not uniformly higher than their base counterparts (hatched bars); for instance, in both Mathverse and MMLU, GRPO (hatched orange) exceeds PPO+Self-reflection (solid green). No bars are visually emphasized through shading, outlines, or annotations beyond their color and pattern coding as defined in the legend.
raw_responses.Chinese:

The horizontal axis categorizes the three benchmarks, each hosting a grouped set of six bars, while the vertical axis represents accuracy percentage, ranging from 50% to 62% with major tick marks at 2% intervals. Each bar within a group is uniquely identified by color and fill pattern: solid blue for DAPO+Self-reflection, hatched blue for DAPO, solid orange for SRPO, hatched orange for GRPO, solid green for PPO+Self-reflection, and hatched green for PPO. In the Mathverse group, SRPO (solid orange) reaches approximately 56%, DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue) is near 55%, DAPO (hatched blue) and PPO (hatched green) are around 53%, and GRPO (hatched orange) and PPO+Self-reflection (solid green) are both near 54%. In MMLU, GRPO (hatched orange) leads at approximately 57%, followed closely by DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue) at 57%, SRPO (solid orange) at 57%, DAPO (hatched blue) at 56%, PPO+Self-reflection (solid green) at 56%, and PPO (hatched green) at 54.5%. In Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue) peaks at approximately 61%, SRPO (solid orange) follows at 60.5%, DAPO (hatched blue) is at 57.5%, GRPO (hatched orange) at 58%, PPO+Self-reflection (solid green) at 59%, and PPO (hatched green) at 57%. The bars within each benchmark group are arranged in a fixed order from left to right as per the legend, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or annotations beyond their standard color and pattern coding.

raw_responses.English:

The horizontal axis categorizes the three benchmarks in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis represents Accuracy (%) on a linear scale ranging from 50 to 62, with major tick marks at 2% intervals. Each benchmark group contains six vertically oriented bars, color-coded and patterned according to the legend: solid blue for DAPO+Self-reflection, hatched blue for DAPO, solid orange for SRPO, hatched orange for GRPO, solid green for PPO+Self-reflection, and hatched green for PPO. In Mathverse, the SRPO bar (solid orange) reaches approximately 56%, the tallest in that group, followed by DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue) at ~55%; DAPO (hatched blue), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green) range between ~53% and 54%. In MMLU, GRPO (hatched orange) is highest at ~57%, closely followed by DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue) at ~56.5%, with SRPO (solid orange) at ~57%, PPO+Self-reflection (solid green) at ~56%, DAPO (hatched blue) at ~56%, and PPO (hatched green) at ~54.5%. In Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue) peaks at ~61%, SRPO (solid orange) is second at ~60.5%, GRPO (hatched orange) at ~58%, PPO+Self-reflection (solid green) at ~59%, DAPO (hatched blue) at ~57.5%, and PPO (hatched green) at ~57%. The bars within each benchmark group are not sorted by height, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their assigned color and pattern; the chart visually conveys that self-reflection variants do not uniformly outperform their base counterparts, as GRPO exceeds PPO+Self-reflection in both Mathverse and MMLU.

raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Das Balkendiagramm vergleicht die Genauigkeit (in Prozent) von sechs verschiedenen Verstärkungslernkonfigurationen — DAPO+Self-reflection (durchgehend blau), DAPO (blau mit Schraffur), SRPO (durchgehend orange), GRPO (orange mit Schraffur), PPO+Self-reflection (durchgehend grün) und PPO (grün mit Schraffur) — über drei Benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Die horizontale Achse listet die drei Benchmarks in dieser Reihenfolge auf, während die vertikale Achse die Genauigkeit in Prozent anzeigt, mit einer Skala von 50 % bis 62 % und Tick-Markierungen in 2 %-Schritten. In Mathverse erreicht SRPO mit etwa 56 % den höchsten Wert, gefolgt von DAPO+Self-reflection bei etwa 55 %, während die übrigen Methoden zwischen 53 % und 54 % liegen. Im MMLU-Benchmark liegt GRPO mit etwa 57 % an der Spitze, leicht vor DAPO+Self-reflection, und PPO liegt mit etwa 54,5 % am Ende. Im Physics-Benchmark erreicht DAPO+Self-reflection etwa 61 %, SRPO etwa 60,5 %, und PPO liegt mit etwa 57 % am niedrigsten. Die Balken sind gruppiert nach Benchmark, wobei jede Gruppe sechs nebeneinander angeordnete Balken enthält, die durch Farbe und Füllmuster unterschieden werden. Es gibt keine explizite Sortierung der Balken innerhalb jeder Gruppe, und keine Balken sind visuell hervorgehoben; die Farb- und Musterkodierung wird durch die Legende oben rechts erklärt.
